files.name: motion-prompt-029.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Tracking shot" (トラッキング), one of the names in "Camera moves & transitions".
Motion Prompt #029

What it is: Move along with the subject
What the sample shows: The camera moves sideways at the same speed as a walking person; the person stays centred while nearer posts sweep past faster.
Spec:
- Camera: moves right at a constant 1.7 m/s (x = -4.0 m → +4.0 m in 4.7 s); height 1.3 m, facing straight ahead; no easing
- Subject: a person walks at the same x as the camera (7.5 m away) and stays in the centre of frame; legs and arms swing by sin(u×7)×0.42 rad
- Parallax: posts every 1.6 m at 4 m depth sweep left fastest, then trees, then buildings (48 m away); mountains hardly move
- Top-right readout shows "→ 1.7m/s"
- Repeat: jumps back to the start every 4.7 s (posts and ground grid line up at the seam; background buildings and trees jump)
When to use it: To follow a walking or running subject and keep the sense of movement while showing their action.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/029.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/camera.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
